# Final Review Proposal
**Producer:** agent:codex/gpt-5.4

## Summary

Found two blocking issues. First, the root repository diff does not include the `tank_core` edits at all; it only records the nested worktree as dirty. Second, even inside that nested worktree, the changes implement nitrification/alkalinity accounting rather than the requested chloride-aware nitrite hazard in shrimp stress.

## Amendments

1. Move the implementation into the repository that is actually under review. From `/home/master/p/tank-simulation`, `git diff` only changes `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7:1`; the real code edits live only inside the nested worktree repo (for example `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:15-23` and `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:10-27`). As submitted from the root repo, none of the `tank_core` implementation or tests would ship.
   Rationale: The top-level patch currently contains only a dirty worktree/gitlink marker, so the intended behavior change is not actually part of the deliverable.
2. Implement the requested chloride-aware nitrite hazard in the shrimp stress path. `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:18-43` still computes `hourly_nitrite_stress_accum` solely from `nitrite_mg_l`, with no chloride modifier and no species-level `chloride_protection_factor`. The modified files instead add alkalinity bookkeeping and tracing (`crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:10-27,337-338`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:15-23,366-385`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/water_change.rs:131-152`, `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:229-239`). Equal nitrite therefore still implies equal hazard regardless of chloride, and the bead’s chloride/salt-treatment acceptance criteria remain unimplemented.
   Rationale: This is the core functional requirement of the task. Without changing the nitrite-stress calculation or adding the species parameter, the feature is not present.
